request-path.alt: A customer sends an order through the load balancer. The ECS application borrows a connection from HikariCP and writes to PostgreSQL on Amazon RDS.

investigation.alt: Check metrics, traces, logs and pool settings. Compare one changed task with the others and check the limits before expanding the rollout.

private-app-s3/request-path.alt: Inside one AWS Region, a browser reaches an internet-facing ALB spanning two public subnets. Its nodes open separate HTTPS connections to EC2 targets in private subnets. Each private subnet has its own S3 route to a shared VPC gateway endpoint. The S3 bucket is outside the VPC.
